name: quality
description: Make the code correct, clean, and current. Opens the PR first so CI and review bots run during the review, then harvests their results before it finishes. A thermo dual-review: a correctness/security track and a maintainability/code-judo track run in parallel, then a synthesis step dedupes, severity-ranks (Blocker/High/Medium/ Low), verifies each finding against the real code, and FIXES EVERY VERIFIED FINDING at any severity — re-reviewing only the fix delta, with a cap. Windows parity is a default requirement for all new code. Only findings needing a product decision, a behavior change this branch was not asked to make, or a capability whose Windows parity is not achievable, reach the merge-blocking gate. Grounded in ADE's own bug classes (runtime-backed null services, daemon action-domain wiring, cr-sqlite CRR, IPC contract drift, fast-tier loading).
